title: Borrow One Input Only
goal: Allow mutating the unreturned parameter while keeping the returned reference.
hints: Look at what main does to tag while p is still active.
Tag does not need to share lifetime 'a with the returned reference.
explanation: Tying `_t` to `'a` forces `tag` to remain borrowed as long as `p` lives, causing `E0502` when calling `tag.clear()`. Giving `s` the type `&'a str` and `_t` an unannotated `&str` assigns `_t` its own independent lifetime, allowing `tag` to be mutated immediately after the function call. Using `&'b str` without declaring `'b` produces `E0261`, and passing `String` causes type mismatch `E0308`.
